name: remote-job-monitor
description: Track local, SSH, and GitHub publish jobs with event-driven waits and a token-free live dashboard.

interface.shortDescription: Await jobs and GitHub publishing without model polling.
interface.longDescription: Tracks local and SSH command lifecycles plus Git commit, push, and Actions phases; waits inside the MCP server and renders a live dashboard without repeated model turns.
